title: Powell Industries announces third quarter fiscal 2026 results
publisher: Powell Industries, Inc. via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: Fiscal Q3 revenue was USD 311.7 million, gross margin 30.6%, orders USD 934 million, backlog USD 2.4 billion and cash USD 633.6 million.
summary: The current SEC-filed release reports a 3.0x book-to-bill ratio and three megaprojects, led by a data-center order above USD 400 million for a behind-the-meter design around on-site generation assets, while nine-month data-center awards exceeded USD 800 million.
